name: Tomato Rarebit
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)

ingredients.item: ¾ cup stewed and strained tomatoes

steps: Put butter in chafing-dish; when melted, add flour.
Pour on, gradually, cream, and as soon as mixture thickens add tomatoes mixed with soda; then add cheese, eggs, and seasonings to taste.
Serve, as soon as cheese has melted, on Graham Toast.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
